subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should the dedicated private AWS workspace API and ECS deployment become a permanently supported core Crabbox mode?
rationale: This adds a substantial API, deployment stack, configuration contract, and ongoing security and operations burden; the visible sponsorship statement comes from an account classified as CONTRIBUTOR rather than confirmed repository-owner metadata.

options.title: Sponsor as core mode
options.body: Accept the long-term API, deployment, security, and operations boundary after the correctness blockers and exact-head proof are complete.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Move the dedicated deployment and policy into an external integration while retaining only generic provider capabilities in core.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Pause both branches until a supported deployment owner and maintenance plan are established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor as core mode
recommendation.body: Accept the long-term API, deployment, security, and operations boundary after the correctness blockers and exact-head proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across the affected AWS, fleet, and Node coordinator paths and is the best available routing owner for the product decision.
